details: Bitcoin surged past $79,500, igniting optimism for a new bull market, supported by regulatory developments, broader altcoin gains, and increased U.S. Treasury liquidity. This rally has defied earlier bearish predictions and is accompanied by significant ETF inflows.
title: Bitcoin Breaks $79,500 Amid Regulatory Hopes & Treasury Buybacks

details: Ethereum has climbed almost 30% over the past week, driven by renewed spot ETF inflows and a significant short squeeze, pushing prices higher. This momentum has also revived ambitious price targets of $4,000-$5,000 for ETH.
title: Ethereum Surges 30% in a Week on ETF Inflows & Short Squeeze

details: The broader cryptocurrency market experienced a significant pullback over the weekend, leading to nearly $882 million in liquidations for 179,200 traders globally. Long positions accounted for over 85% of these liquidations, with Bitcoin falling 2.40% in 24 hours.
title: Crypto Market Sees $880M Liquidations in Sharp Weekend Pullback

details: XRP saw a strong rally of over 46% this week, reaching a seven-month high, but sharply dropped 14% in the last 24 hours. This sudden pullback triggered over $250 million in long position liquidations, signaling a potential bull trap.
title: XRP Surges 46% Then Drops 14% Amid $250M Long Liquidations

details: Zcash (ZEC) reached an eight-year high, with futures volume approaching $10 billion. This surge is primarily driven by Grayscale's ongoing efforts to launch a Zcash exchange-traded fund (ETF) in the United States, indicating growing institutional interest.
title: Zcash Hits 8-Year High as Grayscale Advances ETF Efforts

details: Solana has successfully reduced its mainnet slot time to 350 milliseconds, marking the first significant step towards its ambitious goal of achieving a 200ms slot time. This enhancement aims to improve network efficiency and accelerate transaction processing speeds.
title: Solana Cuts Mainnet Slot Time to 350ms for Faster Transactions

details: Sentiment across Ethereum (ETH) derivatives has slightly slipped into negative territory over the past week. The Ethereum Net Taker Volume, which measures market order execution in perpetual futures, turned negative, suggesting a shift towards net selling in these markets.
title: Ethereum Derivatives Sentiment Turns Negative Amid Price Volatility

details: Bitcoin traded at $76,536, down 0.8% over 24 hours, after giving up earlier gains that had pushed it above the $77,000 mark. This decline occurred even as the recent market rally had improved the profitability of Bitcoin mining operations.
title: Bitcoin Slips Under $77K Despite Improved Mining Economics

details: Cardano (ADA) experienced a significant price decline, trading down 10.33% on the day. This drop reflects a prevailing bearish market sentiment affecting the altcoin.
title: Cardano Price Drops 10% Amid Bearish Market Sentiment
